en.name: High knee lifts
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand tall with space in front of you. Let your teacher see you from the side.
Lift one knee to a comfortable height. If your teacher agrees, work towards a level thigh without leaning back.
Lower the foot and stand on both feet.
Lift the other knee and let your arms swing naturally; keep one foot on the floor.
Return to both feet. Use a lower lift whenever you need to.
en.focus: Teacher marks one lift and return. Height is optional; this is separate from the lower alternating knee-lift exercise.

zh-Hant.name: 高抬腿
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 站直並在前方留出空間，讓老師從側面觀察。
提起一邊膝蓋至舒適高度；老師認為合適時，才逐漸嘗試大腿接近水平，不要向後仰。
把腳放下，回到雙腳站立。
換另一邊提膝，雙臂自然擺動，保持一隻腳留在地上。
回到雙腳站立，需要時把提膝高度降低。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把一次提膝及放下記作一次；高度由老師調整，也可選擇較低的「交替提膝」。
